Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. In order to play an [Gabumon], the Digimon card's name can only be [Gabumon].
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card’s effect to play a Digimon with [Gabumon] in its name such as [Gabumon - Bond of Friendship] or [Gabumon (X Antibody)]?

Effect: [Security] You may play 1 [Gabumon] or 1 Tamer card with [Matt Ishida] in its name from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
[When Digivolving] ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, trash 1 card in your hand.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, trash 1 card in your hand.
